Without paging it answers the latest messages; after=<seq> answers the new ones since the last check. A reply that went stale starts again here.

before.description: The messages before this seq (older ones; ignored with after).

limit.description: How many of the latest (or of those before before); ignored with after.

kind.description: user: a verified Accounts sign-in; guest: the SS-Guest key; none: neither yet.

SS-Guest.description: The guest's key: guestKey of an earlier answer (or an imported store's guest cookie value). Another value counts as no key.

SS-Sign-In.description: The visitor's Accounts sign-in (Signed-in chat on, Accounts token pasted); one that does not verify counts as none. With SS-Guest too, the guest's chats move to the account.

POST /v1/chat/messages.description: A visitor without a key starts a new guest (Guest chat on), answered once in guestKey: keep it on the device and send it in SS-Guest from then on. A message reopens a resolved conversation; the AI reply follows (AI replies on), and a keyword may start a flow or hand the chat to a person. With ?wait=1 the AI reply comes within the request (up to 20 s) in replies; a slower reply is still being written (replyPending: true) and comes with the next checks. 403 sign_in_required (Guest chat off and no sign-in); 403 guest_limit_reached with next (sign_in, lead or none); 422 message_rejected (Moderation's blocked terms); 429 rate_limited (too many new guests from one network); 422 validation_failed. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request sends one message.

wait.description: Wait for the AI reply (up to 20 s).

SS-Guest.description: The guest's key: guestKey of an earlier answer (or an imported store's guest cookie value). Another value counts as no key.

SS-Sign-In.description: The visitor's Accounts sign-in (Signed-in chat on, Accounts token pasted); one that does not verify counts as none. With SS-Guest too, the guest's chats move to the account.

text.description: Trimmed; may be '' or left out beside an attachment.

attachment.description: With Attachments on and visitor uploads allowed: a file uploaded with POST /v1/chat/uploads.

replies.description: With ?wait=1: the messages after the visitor's (the AI reply, bot messages).

replyPending.description: With ?wait=1: the AI reply is still being written.

guestKey.description: Only when a new guest was started: keep it and send it in SS-Guest.

POST /v1/chat/read.description: Clears unread and marks the replies seen (staff see Seen with Read receipts on). 404 not_found when the visitor has no chat yet.

SS-Sign-In.description: The visitor's Accounts sign-in (Signed-in chat on, Accounts token pasted); one that does not verify counts as none. With SS-Guest too, the guest's chats move to the account. One of the two names the visitor: without both, 404 not_found.

POST /v1/chat/end.description: The conversation becomes resolved (a new message reopens it); with Ratings asking on resolve (or after a staff reply that came), ratingRequested becomes true. 404 not_found when the visitor has no chat yet.

SS-Guest.description: The guest's key: guestKey of an earlier answer (or an imported store's guest cookie value). Another value counts as no key.

POST /v1/chat/handoff.description: The chat waits for a person and the AI stops until staff reply or hand it back. The visitor gets the handoff notice (outside office hours: when staff are back), a guest without contact details is asked for them, staff get the Chat needs you alert, and with AI conversation summary on a summary is written. Asking again while it waits changes nothing. 404 not_found when the visitor has no chat yet.

Phones are kept as E.164 (a number without its country code takes your business.json country's code). 422 validation_failed: a value that is not valid, or neither email nor phone.

With a consent text, consent must be true. The visitor's conversation, when there is one, gets the name, email and phone it lacks. 422 validation_failed with every problem. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request makes one lead.

assignee.description: With Assignment on: those assigned to this staff id.

unread.description: 1: only conversations with visitor messages no staff member opened.

userId.description: One customer's conversations: their Accounts user id.

GET /v1/conversations/count.description: The list's own filters. The inbox setting Guest chats in the inbox decides which conversations show: all, guest chats only once handed to a person (escalated), or signed-in visitors' only (signed_in).

status.description: Only conversations with this status (another value filters nothing).

waiting.description: 1: only conversations waiting for a person.

visitor.description: Only guests' or signed-in visitors' conversations.

assigned.description: With Assignment on: unassigned ones, or those assigned to you (the ticket's user, or the SS-Actor-Id of a server call).

assignee.description: With Assignment on: those assigned to this staff id.

unread.description: 1: only conversations with visitor messages no staff member opened.

userId.description: One customer's conversations: their Accounts user id.

GET /v1/conversations/counts.summary: Count the conversations by status, waiting, guest or unread
GET /v1/conversations/counts.description: The list's own filters. The inbox setting Guest chats in the inbox decides which conversations show: all, guest chats only once handed to a person (escalated), or signed-in visitors' only (signed_in).

by.description: status; waiting (true/false); guest (the visitor is a guest: true/false); unread (visitor messages no staff member opened: true/false).

status.description: Only conversations with this status (another value filters nothing).

waiting.description: 1: only conversations waiting for a person.

visitor.description: Only guests' or signed-in visitors' conversations.

assigned.description: With Assignment on: unassigned ones, or those assigned to you (the ticket's user, or the SS-Actor-Id of a server call).

assignee.description: With Assignment on: those assigned to this staff id.

unread.description: 1: only conversations with visitor messages no staff member opened.

userId.description: One customer's conversations: their Accounts user id.

q.description: Search the visitor's name, email and phone and the visible message texts (any case; the first 100 characters).

GET /v1/conversations/:id.description: Without paging the latest 100 messages; after=<seq> answers the new ones. 404 not_found.

after.description: Only the messages after this seq (up to 200).

before.description: The messages before this seq (older ones, up to 50; ignored with after).

limit.description: How many of the latest (up to 100; with before up to 50, default 50); ignored with after.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/read.summary: Mark the conversation read by staff
POST /v1/conversations/:id/read.description: Clears its unread count; the visitor sees Seen (Read receipts), and the next visitor message alerts staff again.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/messages.description: Markdown, written as the member of staff the SS-Actor headers name (else Team). It ends waiting for a person, moves open to awaiting_visitor, and with Assign automatically set to first replier assigns an unassigned chat to a member of staff with room; a visitor who left gets a reply alert (Reply alerts to visitors, by the first of its Channels, in order, that the visitor has an address for and Notifications takes). Links stay links when they point to your website, or as Moderation's link policy allows. 422 validation_failed; 403 feature_off (an attachment with Attachments off).

text.description: Trimmed; may be '' or left out beside an attachment.

attachment.description: A file uploaded with POST /v1/uploads (staff types, up to the staff size setting).

POST /v1/conversations/:id/notes.description: Notes as a timeline (the default mode): a note between the messages that only your staff see. 409 conflict in the mode one note per chat (use PUT …/note); 422 validation_failed.

PUT /v1/conversations/:id/note.description: Notes in the mode one note per chat. 409 conflict in the timeline mode (use POST …/notes); 422 validation_failed.

PUT /v1/conversations/:id/ai.summary: Pause or resume the AI in the conversation
PUT /v1/conversations/:id/ai.description: Keeps who paused it, when and why. Resuming also hands a chat waiting for a person back to the AI. 422 validation_failed.

PATCH /v1/conversations/:id.summary: Change status, AI pause, assignment or custom field values
PATCH /v1/conversations/:id.description: Send any of them (at least one). resolved ends waiting and, with Ratings asking on resolve (or after a staff reply that came), asks for a rating. assignedTo needs Assignment: someone on the staff list, or an Accounts user whose role may reply in the inbox (with the Accounts token); 409 staff_full when they have the most open chats they can take. fields needs Custom fields: null or '' clears a value. Each change is written to the activity log. 422 validation_failed; 403 feature_off.

aiPaused.description: false also hands a chat waiting for a person back to the AI.

aiPausedReason.description: With aiPaused true; cut to 200 characters.

fields.description: Custom field values by key, checked as the field's type.

DELETE /v1/conversations/:id.description: With its messages, attachments (from your storage), the guest records behind it and the staff alerts still waiting to be sent about it. 404 not_found.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/summary.description: Kept on the conversation; it counts toward the AI token caps. 503 ai_unavailable (no AI key, a cap reached, or the AI failed).

POST /v1/conversations/:id/transcript.summary: Email a copy of the conversation
POST /v1/conversations/:id/transcript.description: The template chat.transcript through Notifications (paste its token in Connections) with the whole chat in its values transcript, transcript2 … transcript45 (Notifications takes values of up to 1,000 characters: 45,000 in all); a longer chat sends its latest messages after a line that says how many (widget text transcript.earlier). 503 notifications_not_connected; 502 not_sent; 422 validation_failed.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/rating-reques.summary: Ask the visitor for a rating
POST /v1/conversations/:id/rating-reques.description: The visitor's chat shows the rating question (ratingRequested).

POST /v1/uploads.description: A presigned PUT into your storage for one of the staff types setting (Word, Excel and text files are downloads only) up to the staff size setting (at most 100 MB). 503 storage_not_connected; 422 validation_failed (type or size).

name.description: Cut to 120 characters; \ / " and line breaks become _.

type.description: One of the staff types setting.

size.description: Bytes, up to the staff size setting.

GET /v1/inbox/unread.description: Over the conversations the inbox shows. The inbox setting Guest chats in the inbox decides which conversations show: all, guest chats only once handed to a person (escalated), or signed-in visitors' only (signed_in).

unread.description: Visitor messages no staff member opened.

POST /v1/data/delete-all.description: For going live without your test chats: every conversation with its messages, attachments (from your storage), the guest records behind it and staff alerts still waiting to be sent about it. Leads stay (they are records of their own). 100 conversations at a time: after 8 seconds the answer says more, and the next call goes on where it stopped. confirm repeats the website's domain (422 validation_failed at /confirm, at /scope for another scope). Server token only; each call writes one activity entry (data.deleted_all) with its counts.

confirm.description: The website's domain, for example shop.example.com.

files.description: Attachments deleted from your storage (one storage cannot delete now is left there).

alerts.description: Staff alerts that were still waiting to be sent.

GET /v1/staff.description: By name, with presence, open chats and limits (Staff presence and max chats).

GET /v1/knowledge/entries.summary: Knowledge base entries, last changed first

q.description: Search titles and texts (any case; the first 100 characters).

POST /v1/knowledge/entries.summary: Add an FAQ entry or article
POST /v1/knowledge/entries.description: Indexed for the AI at once. Up to 2,000 entries. 422 validation_failed.

GET /v1/knowledge/pages.summary: Website pages as knowledge, newest first

POST /v1/knowledge/pages.description: Fetched now (10 s, at most 2 MB) and indexed; a page that cannot be fetched is kept with status failed and its reason. Up to 200 pages. 422 validation_failed.

POST /v1/knowledge/pages/:id/fetch.description: Pages are fetched only when added and with this call, never on a schedule. 404 not_found.

GET /v1/reports.summary: Reports for a range of days
GET /v1/reports.description: Days in the business.json time zone. 422 validation_failed for another range.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, not before from, at most 366 days in all; default today.

POST /v1/import/:collection.description: collection is staff, guests, conversations or messages. The body is application/x-ndjson: one record per line in Chat's own shapes (at most 1,000 records or 4 MB per call), each written by its key (id; keyHash for guests) and replaced when it is there already, so running it again changes nothing. Unknown fields and the tenant fields are refused by name, and text longer than Chat keeps is refused, never cut. Import staff first, then guests, conversations and their messages, then call finish. Nothing is sent: no message, event, alert or AI call. ?dryRun=1 checks without writing. 404 not_found for another collection; 415 unsupported_media_type; 413 payload_too_large.

id.description: The record's key (null when it has none).

failed.description: The records not written, by line.

POST /v1/import/:collection/prune.summary: Remove imported records the source no longer has
POST /v1/import/:collection/prune.description: collection is staff, guests, conversations or messages. Records an import wrote whose key lies after after and up to through (open ends when left out) and is not kept are removed, at most 1,000 per call (more: call again). Records made in Chat itself are never removed. ?dryRun=1 answers what would go. 415 unsupported_media_type (send application/json); 422 validation_failed.

keep.description: The source's keys in this range, sorted.

through.description: Only keys up to this one.

keys.description: The keys removed (or, with dryRun, that would go).

POST /v1/import/finish.summary: Number the imported messages and derive what conversations keep
POST /v1/import/finish.description: The next 100 imported conversations by id: their messages numbered 1..n in time order (ties by id), and their counters, preview, last message time and read marks derived. While more is true, call again with ?after=<next>. Running it again changes nothing. 422 validation_failed for another after.

next.description: Pass it as after while more is true.

GET /v1/import/status.description: Records per collection, those an import wrote, and the sums ss-import verify compares.
